How Ratings Are Derived

Ratings are derived by considering several parameters, including:

  1. Competence of faculty
  2. Academic reputation
  3. Curriculum & pedagogy
  4. Infrastructure provision
  5. Mental & emotional well-being services
  6. Sports education
  7. Leadership opportunities
  8. Individual attention to students
  9. Management quality
  10. Parental involvement
  11. Teacher welfare
  12. Co-curricular education & Internationalisation
  13. Community service
  14. Special needs education
